name: PostOverride
doc: One group of settings a post-process volume overrides: pick the group in module, then tick the properties to change. Unticked properties are left to lower-priority volumes and the defaults.

fields.name: module
fields.doc: The settings group this entry changes.

fields.name: exposure
fields.doc: Automatic metering or a fixed exposure.

fields.name: ev100
fields.doc: Manual exposure value at ISO 100 (manual mode). Sunny day ≈ 15, overcast ≈ 12, sunset ≈ 10, lit interior ≈ 7, night street ≈ 3.

fields.name: compensation
fields.doc: Exposure compensation in stops, applied in both modes; +1 doubles the brightness.

fields.name: minEv100
fields.doc: Darkest exposure automatic metering may pick (lower = brighter in dark scenes).

fields.name: maxEv100
fields.doc: Brightest exposure automatic metering may pick.

fields.name: adaptationSpeed
fields.doc: How fast automatic exposure adapts, per second; higher reacts faster.

fields.name: toneMapping
fields.doc: Display transform that compresses scene radiance into the screen's range.

fields.name: bloom
fields.doc: Fraction of light spread into the bloom glow around bright pixels.

fields.name: whiteBalance
fields.doc: White balance: the colour temperature that renders as neutral white. Lower warms the image's whites to neutral (tungsten ≈ 3200), higher cools them.

fields.name: saturation
fields.doc: Colour saturation; 0 is greyscale, 1 unchanged.

fields.name: contrast
fields.doc: Contrast around middle grey; 1 unchanged.

fields.name: lift
fields.doc: Lift: a colour added to the shadows after tone mapping, fading out toward white; black leaves them unchanged.

fields.name: gamma
fields.doc: Gamma: a per-channel midtone power after tone mapping; white is neutral, a darker channel darkens that channel's midtones.

fields.name: gain
fields.doc: Gain: a per-channel multiplier on the whole image after tone mapping; white is neutral.

fields.name: lut
fields.doc: Colour lookup table applied last, as in Unity and Unreal: a strip texture of 16 (256x16) or 32 (1024x32) sRGB slices along red and green, one slice per blue step, imported uncompressed.

fields.name: lutContribution
fields.doc: How much of the lookup table applies, from 0 (none) to 1 (all).

fields.name: vignette
fields.doc: Darkening toward the frame corners; 0 disables it.

fields.name: focusDistance
fields.doc: Distance from the camera that is in focus; 0 turns depth of field off.

fields.name: aperture
fields.doc: Lens aperture as an f-number: smaller numbers blur more (f/1.4 is shallow, f/16 keeps nearly everything sharp). The focal length follows the camera's field of view on a full-frame sensor.

fields.name: nearBlur
fields.doc: Strength of the blur in front of the focus distance, from 0 (sharp) to 1 (physical).

fields.name: farBlur
fields.doc: Strength of the blur behind the focus distance, from 0 (sharp) to 1 (physical).

fields.name: shutterAngle
fields.doc: Shutter angle: 180° blurs motion over half a frame, 360° over a whole frame; 0 turns motion blur off. Samples per pixel follow the quality preset.

fields.name: chromaticAberration
fields.doc: Strength of the red/blue fringes toward the frame edges; 0 turns it off.

fields.name: aoIntensity
fields.doc: Ambient occlusion strength: 0 none, 1 physical, above 1 exaggerated.

fields.name: aoRadius
fields.doc: Ambient occlusion search radius.

fields.name: reflectionIntensity
fields.doc: Screen-space reflection strength, from 0 (probe reflections only) to 1.

fields.name: reflectionDistance
fields.doc: Longest screen-space reflection ray.
